name: iopv_prem_z_cross_vel_15s
hypothesis: Premium-arbitrage regime reversal events: 300s z of iopv_premium crosses zero within 15s. Crossing velocity scores how fast AP pressure reverses; decisive crossings continue at 15-60s. Event-sparse, unlike library level-z.

name: iopv_prem_zvel_extreme_60s
hypothesis: Extremity-weighted premium-regime velocity: 60s z-velocity of iopv_premium weighted by |z|. Stretched premium still accelerating means mispricing widening beyond AP response; 60s matches AP timescale.

name: iopv_prem_zvel_div_60s
hypothesis: Premium level-vs-velocity disagreement: z(premium) minus z(its 60s velocity). Stretched level with fading velocity means AP arb closing; velocity leading means still building.

name: rv60_logzvel_div_60s
